config.profilePasses: Separate untimed diagnostic passes for finder, scroll, editor, tree/search and memory
config.aggregation: Pooled action samples across all runs; nearest-rank p95, interpolated median
config.cold: Fresh browser context, empty HTTP cache, indexed long-running server; not cold OS/backend cache

memory.note: One cycle measures retained growth, not proof of a leak; closed-tab history may intentionally retain state.
